answer: Decay 4% per idle epoch. Vest 90 days. An identity skipping 5 epochs loses 18% and its payout starts three months late. A farm of 400 idle accounts holds 400 decay clocks and cannot restart one by paying. The vine grows an epoch at a time, the atlas of standing is rebuilt and never bought, and a fresh oasis of 400 accounts waits 90 days before it earns a cent.
